correctness.rationale: PASS: B=I-A/L is simultaneously entrywise nonnegative and PSD for SPD Stieltjes A with L spectral maximum. From x_(m+1)=p_m(B)b/L, the exact polynomial recurrence gives p0=1, p1=1+(1+β)z, p2=1+z+(1+β)^2 z^2, p3=1+z+(1-β²)z²+(1+β)^3 z³, p4=1+z+z²+(1+β)²(1-2β)z³+(1+β)^4z⁴. All coefficients through p3 nonnegative; p4 likewise for β<=1/2 iff κ<=9. For κ>9, the PSD nonnegative four-path block C with (C³)_14=1,(C⁴)_14=6 embedded as Bε=diag(εC,1-1/κ) has exact spectral endpoints and a negative order-ε³ x5_1 for sufficiently small ε (despite positive ε⁴ term). Independently iterated the stated rational κ16 five-by-five matrix and found x5_1=-77/31250000000, with earlier first-coordinate values nonnegative. All-real κ sharpness rests on ε inequalities, not that sample.
